findings.q1: 898 employees improved and 230 declined; the average latest rating is 3.41.
findings.q2: 317 employees are 2+ levels short of a required skill (325 of 4,000 assessments).
findings.q3: 166 promotion candidates; 132 could move up with no skill gap to close.
findings.q4: 5,105 courses completed and 1,755 certifications earned; 149 employees have none.
findings.q5: 145 employees are flagged High risk by both HR and the data; 419 by at least one view.
findings.q6: Higher-rated teams deliver on time more often (r = 0.54); 5 teams rate high but deliver low.
findings.q7: Customer- and stakeholder-facing skills have the lowest coverage org-wide.
findings.q8: Talent labels barely track performance (147 'Ready Now' employees rated 1-2), and only 18 of 325 critical gaps have a completed course.
